title: Protect your Nodestro data
refused: Nodestro did not open its database because other users of this computer may change it. Your workflows, keys and results belong to you alone: restrict the database files to your user.
requested: You asked to restrict the database files to your user. Check the change and confirm it.

skipped.hard_link: Left alone: the file has another name (hard link)
skipped.other_owner: Left alone: belongs to another user
skipped.not_a_file: Left alone: not a regular file
skipped.changed_during_repair: Left alone: changed during the repair

what: Nodestro changes only the permissions of these files, never their content. Nothing changes until you confirm.
confirm: Yes, from now on only my user may access these files.
notRepairable: Nodestro cannot repair these files itself. Repair them by hand, then start Nodestro again.
manual: Or repair it yourself in a terminal:
cancelled: Nothing was changed. Nodestro stays locked until the permissions of the database are repaired.
cancelledRequested: Nothing was changed. Close Nodestro and start it again to continue without the repair.
repaired: Done: only your user can access the database now. Nodestro restarts.
failedTitle: The permissions could not be repaired completely. Nodestro stays locked.
planChanged: The files changed since they were shown. Check them again before you confirm.
loadFailed: The database files could not be checked.
